sources.snippet: ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct is Liquid AI's flagship instruction-tuned model, delivering exceptional performance for chat, instruction-following, and tool-calling tasks. Built on the LFM2.5 architecture with extended pre-training and reinforcement learning.

sources.title: LFM2.5 Q4_0: Quantization-Aware Distillation for Edge Deployment
sources.snippet: Today, we release updated 4-bit checkpoints for LFM2.5-230M, LFM2.5-350M, LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct, and LFM2.5-2.6B trained with Quantization-Aware Distillation (QAD). QAD is a technique to distill a high-precision teacher model into a quantized student model.
